Commercial Wear Replaced by Master Craftsmanship

High-traffic restaurants experience relentless UV bleaching, water rings, and mechanical wear. We restore prime assets to showroom prestige.

Commercial Teak & Hardwood Tables
Overnight Service
Before • UV Bleached
After • Deep Oiled

The Wear: Sun exposure and spills cause silver-gray oxidation, wine rings, and micro-cracking in solid timber.

The Renewal: Deep artisanal sanding, stain extraction, and food-safe Danish hardwax oil that creates a water-beading satin shield.

Outdoor Wicker & Cane Re-Weaving
75% Replacement Savings
Before • Broken Weave
After • Re-Woven

The Wear: UV brittleness and heavy guest use snap synthetic and natural cane, exposing sharp metal frames.

The Renewal: Skilled female artisans in our Kew workshop hand-cane matching weave, re-tensioning the entire structural frame.

Dustless Hardwood Floor Revitalisation
Zero Dust Contamination
Active Sanding • Half Refinished

The Wear: Heel scuffs, chair dragging, and entryway traffic erode floor sealants down to raw discolored grain.

The Renewal: Industrial HEPA-vacuum dustless sanding followed by fast-curing commercial polyurethane, ready for morning service.

Banquette Seating & Reupholstery
High-Density Contract Grade
Internal Rebuild • Finished Luxury

The Wear: Sagging seat springs, collapsed foam cushions, and creased leather degrade dining posture and satisfaction.

The Renewal: Internal timber reinforcement, high-resilience memory foam, and spill-resistant contract leather or performance fabrics.
